142	
143	- **`@gravity-ui/uikit` MUST be installed in every Gravity UI project.** It is
144	  the base component + design-token library every other `@gravity-ui/*` package
145	  builds on; without it components render unstyled. If `package.json` lacks it,
146	  stop and have the user install and configure it first (setup:

149	  assume a package is installed; never assume its major version.
150	- **Do not invent props or components.** Before using a component API you are

152	  and the component's README in `dist/docs`. If still unsure, ask the user
153	  rather than guessing.

155	  match an icon from a screenshot/photo/mock, run `scripts/icon-image-search.sh`
156	  (reverse image search). With only a description, look the name up on

158	  object (`<Icon data={CheckIcon} />`), never a string key. See

161	  `blue-500`); never hand-write `dark:` overrides. Full token tables live in
162	  `references/theming.md`; the cross-cutting traps (partial brand overrides,

164	  `rules/hallucination-traps.md`.

166	  peer-deps). It lives in each package's root README under "Required setup" —
167	  read it once per package, do not rely on memory.

172	already implied by the rules above; this section exists as an explicit
173	stop-sign. If you are about to do any of these, stop and re-ground.

183	  serves the newest major, which may differ from the installed one and have a
184	  different API. The versioned online fallback is the major-line URL

188	  UI. Override the full brand token set, on each theme you support.
189	- **Do not override internal markup with `[class*='…']` / ID selectors.**
190	  That's written against one DOM structure and breaks silently when the
191	  component changes. Climb the customization ladder
192	  (global token → component CSS API → narrow flagged hack) before ever
193	  touching structure.

196

198

200	  (`gravity-ui.com/llms.txt`), refreshed each skill release. Used as the
201	  offline fallback in Step 0.
202	- `references/theming.md` — verbatim copy of uikit's `docs/theming.md`:

205	  `node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md` for the
206	  version-matched file.
207	- `references/layout.md` — verbatim copy of uikit's `docs/layout.md`:
208	  spacing scale (`--g-spacing-*`), `Flex`/`Box`, `Row`/`Col`/`Container`
209	  grid, breakpoints, `useLayoutContext`.
210	- `references/icons.md` — finding an icon by image
211	  (`scripts/icon-image-search.sh`) or on gravity-ui.com/icons; the
212	  object-vs-string rendering rule.

214	  commonly invented APIs: typography variants (`header-3..6` don't exist, no
215	  `Heading`), the flex contract (`min-width:0`, who shrinks), theming traps
216	  (partial brand overrides, a `ThemeProvider` that themes the whole page, customization
217	  ladder), `Button view` not `variant`, `Icon data` not `name`. Per-component
218	  traps live in each package's `dist/docs`, not here.

# @gravity-ui/markdown-editor documentation

Documentation for the **installed** version of `@gravity-ui/markdown-editor`.
Your training data may be outdated — these files are the source of truth.

## For AI agents

A dual-mode Markdown editor for React that combines a WYSIWYG mode (ProseMirror) and a raw markup mode (CodeMirror), with support for basic Markdown and YFM.

### When to use

- Editing Markdown/YFM content with a switchable visual (WYSIWYG) and source (markup) view.
- You need an extensible editor: custom marks, nodes, toolbar items, and extensions (HTML, LaTeX, Mermaid, GPT) via the ProseMirror/CodeMirror engines.
- Rendering the editor UI: create the instance with `useMarkdownEditor` and render it with `MarkdownEditorView`.

### When not to use

- Read-only rendering of Markdown to HTML with no editing — transform it with [`@diplodoc/transform`](https://github.com/diplodoc-platform/transform) and render the output instead.
- Plain multiline text input — use `TextArea` from [`@gravity-ui/uikit`](https://github.com/gravity-ui/uikit).
- Rich-text that is not Markdown/YFM — this editor is Markdown-first.

### Common pitfalls

- **It is a hook plus a view, not one component.** Create the instance with `useMarkdownEditor(...)` and pass it to `<MarkdownEditorView editor={editor} />`; there is no single `<MarkdownEditor>` you render directly.
- **Read the value via the instance, not a controlled `value` prop.** Call `editor.getValue()` (e.g. on the `submit` event) to serialize to Markdown; the editor manages its own state.
- **Peer dependencies are required.** Your project must provide `@diplodoc/transform`, `@gravity-ui/uikit`, `@gravity-ui/components`, `react`, and `react-dom` — check the `peerDependencies` in `package.json`.
- **Styles and i18n come from uikit.** Set up theming/styles per the uikit docs and call `configure({lang})` from both this package and `@gravity-ui/uikit`.

## Install

```shell
npm install @gravity-ui/markdown-editor
```

### Required dependencies

Please note that to start using the package, your project must also have the following installed: `@diplodoc/transform`, `react`, `react-dom`, `@gravity-ui/uikit`, `@gravity-ui/components` and some others. Check out the `peerDependencies` section of `package.json` for accurate information.

## Usage

The markdown editor is supplied as a React hook to create an instance of editor and a component for rendering the view.\
To set up styling and theme see [UIKit docs](https://github.com/gravity-ui/uikit?tab=readme-ov-file#styles).

  const editor = useMarkdownEditor({allowHTML: false});

    function submitHandler() {
      // Serialize current content to markdown markup
      const value = editor.getValue();
      onSubmit(value);
    }

    editor.on('submit', submitHandler);
    return () => {
      editor.off('submit', submitHandler);
    };
  }, [onSubmit]);

  return <MarkdownEditorView stickyToolbar autofocus editor={editor} />;
}
```

Я добавил в форму markdown-поле на `@gravity-ui/markdown-editor`. `tsc --noEmit` и `vite build` проходят, но в браузере поле я не открывал.

Форма «Новая заметка» лежит в `src/App.tsx`. В ней есть заголовок (`TextInput`), markdown-поле и кнопка «Отправить». Поле вынесено в `src/MarkdownField.tsx`.

- **Как работает поле:** редактор открывается в WYSIWYG-режиме. Пользователь пишет `**жирный**`, `# Заголовок` или `- список` и сразу видит оформление. С панели инструментов можно переключиться в режим разметки.
- **Отправка:** при отправке из редактора берётся чистый markdown. Если текст пустой, под полем появляется ошибка «Введите текст». Отправленное значение форма показывает под кнопкой как сырой markdown.
- **Безопасность:** HTML в тексте отключён (`md: {html: false}`).

- **Версия `@gravity-ui/components`:** я закрепил `@gravity-ui/components@4.23.1` вместо последней. Последняя версия (4.24+) требует uikit ≥7.44, а в проекте стоит 7.43.0, и без этого `npm install` падал с конфликтом. Если обновишь uikit, можно поднять и `components`.
- **Другие зависимости:** вместе с редактором поставил его обязательные peer-зависимости: `katex`, `markdown-it` и `@diplodoc/transform`, `cut-extension`, `file-extension`, `tabs-extension`.
- **README и типы:** в README редактора указана опция `allowHTML`, а в установленной версии 15.49.0 её нет. Я использовал `md.html` по типам.
- **Размер сборки:** бандл теперь около 2,9 МБ (909 КБ в gzip), и Vite предупреждает о размере. Если это важно, редактор можно подгружать через `React.lazy`.

`tsc` не проверяет вёрстку и контраст. Стоит посмотреть поле в светлой и тёмной темах, на ширине около 375px и около 1400px, а также в состоянии ошибки.
